item.text: All five membership/leadership-transfer fuzz scenarios pass too. Let me record it.

Final turn complete. Report updated at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

This turn I ran the rest of the repository's own fuzz scenarios against the audited library, now that the harness works with pre-vote disabled:

```
go test -count=1 -timeout 200s -run '^(TestRaft_FuzzyLeadershipTransfer|TestRaft_AddMembership|TestRaft_AddRemoveNodesNotLeader|TestRaft_RemoveLeader|TestRaft_RemovePartitionedNode)$' .
ok  github.com/hashicorp/raft/fuzzy  36.675s
```

Combined with last turn's `TestRaft_LeaderPartitions` (99.96 s), the entire shipped fuzzy suite — leadership transfer, membership add/remove, remove leader, remove partitioned node, and repeated leader/nodes partitions — passes against the audited code, each run ending with the harness's own log/FSM consistency verifier. That is a strong, repository-authored independent negative for consensus safety, on top of my own harnesses.

Final state of the audit, unchanged in its conclusions:

- One confirmed defect — `testing.go`'s `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` freezes its reference peer set outside its retry loop, causing intermittent false `peer mismatch` failures in three shipped tests on a healthy cluster. Mechanism-verified (goroutine dump + propagation-lag measurement) and causally validated with a one-line fix that takes the re-tested cases to 0/20.
- No consensus-level defect, across complete source review of the root module plus six independent behavioral methods: the shipped test suite, a 40-test core-consensus batch, three custom invariant harnesses (~16k acked commands), and the repository's own fuzzy partition/membership suite (all clean).
- One open item, stated plainly rather than resolved by assertion: whether that frozen-snapshot helper is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake. It cannot be decided here because the module cache's sumdb records fail signature verification and no pristine upstream reference is reachable offline.
- One secondary, clearly-scoped observation: the in-repo `fuzzy` module is pinned to raft v1.2.0-era APIs and its transport lacks a `RequestPreVote` case, so it cannot drive raft ≥1.7 (pre-vote on by default) without `PreVoteDisabled` — a tooling/submodule version mismatch, not a raft correctness defect.

Everything is preserved for review under `work/`: the report, 25 logs/dumps in `audit-evidence/`, six `//go:build auditdiag` diagnostics, `repro/` tools, `_scratch_fixcheck/`, and `_scratch_fuzzy/`. The captured implementation was never modified (`diff -rq source work` clean; `go vet ./...` passes).
